page.overview:
Who is Jacky Ickx?

Jacques Bernard Edmon Martin Henri "Jacky" Ickx ( or ; born January 1, 1945 in Brussels, Brussels-Capital Region, Belgium) is a Belgian former racing driver who competed in Formula One from to , finishing as runner-up on two occasions ( and ), winning eight Grands Prix and finishing on the podium 25 times.

He drove for (as a Tyrrell Racing entrant), , , , (one race), (one race), , , and .

Outside of F1, he achieved great success in sports car racing, winning the 24 Hours of Le Mans six times, a record that stood until 2005.
